meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为你的项目生成一套分层的 AGENTS.md 文件:根目录一份,再按复杂度评分为部分子目录各写一份,记录结构、命令、约定等给 agent 看的知识。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令、约定写成给 agent 看的文档时触发,比如你运行 /init-deep;可加 --create-new 或 --max-depth 参数。

say.text: 用 /init-deep 给这个仓库补上 AGENTS.md
say.note: 按结构生成或更新各层 AGENTS.md
先读旧文件,删掉后从头生成

howto.what_en: After install, Claude generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a repo: a root file plus complexity-scored subdirectory files documenting structure, commands, and conventions.
howto.when_en: Use it when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents — e.g. running /init-deep, optionally with --create-new or --max-depth.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to document this repo's AGENTS.md
say_en.note: Generates or updates hierarchical AGENTS.md files
Reads old files, deletes all, rebuilds
